section: R4 (codex-plugin-execution-reliability): AGENTS.md generation for /shipwright-adopt and /shipwright-project, plus root AGENTS.md model-slug/reasoning-effort drift-fix

review.finding: is_loadbearing_claude_md's docstring and the module's Policy section still enumerate only CLAUDE.md, even though agents_md_renderer.py now imports this exact function under the alias is_loadbearing_agents_md and applies the same 1KB-threshold policy to AGENTS.md. summary: No blocking findings. Single-source render reuse verified byte-identical via test and by hand; CRLF-preserving newline handling correct and Windows-tested; idempotency marker is an inert HTML comment decoupled from the visible heading, with a test proving a colliding unmarked heading doesn't cause a false already-present; sys.path/import hygiene mirrors the existing pattern; write-project-config.py's new agents_md flag and its regression test are correct and minimal; project-scaffolding.md's greenfield instructions quote the template's actual strings verbatim; root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md drift-fix is complete with no leaked model slug/reasoning-effort value remaining, guarded by a new test. Both low-severity findings above were fixed in the same pass (docstrings updated to name AGENTS.md; the unrelated import reformat reverted).
